summary: Chapter 2 restages Feuz's discovery of the Vogel file and the Stettler/Berta/Rutz confrontations from canon, but along the way renames the victim, invents an autopsy that contradicts Melchior's cause of death and the reused-formula device, changes Stettler's office, reassigns Feuz's signature habit to Stettler's old file, and stages the canonical Berta/Vogel exchange with the wrong participant in an unestablished domestic setting.

issues.fix_hint: Name her Klara Vogel, as canon and the name registry record; 'Anna' and 'geborene Aebi' (which also invents kinship to the Aebischer family) do not exist in canon.

issues.unit: die Zusammensetzung des Präparats, das man im Magen gefunden hatte
issues.fix_hint: Cut the poison-in-stomach detail; canon records Melchior's death as a fall of ~12m into the Chrachen with no autopsy performed.
Call him Amtsarzt (district physician), as canon does, not Amtsstatthalter.

issues.unit: Auch hier ein Sektionsbefund, auch hier die Formel
issues.fix_hint: Restore the reused formula as 'Herzversagen, vermutlich beim Sturz'; do not replace it with a poison-composition Sektionsbefund for either case.

issues.unit: Zu Hause hatte Berta die Suppe schon aufgetragen
issues.fix_hint: Set the Vogel exchange between Stettler and Berta as canon specifies for t6; remove Feuz's domestic presence with Berta, a household relationship canon does not establish.

issues.unit: keinen Amtsstatthalter seine Unterschrift unterstreichen sehen
issues.fix_hint: Double-underlining is Feuz's own established habit; don't attach it to Stettler's old file signature as if it were unusual behavior belonging to someone else.
